name: Serafino
source:
An incorrigible womaniser, Serafino is a frivolous man who aims for success purely to hit it off with the ladies. He's descended from a long line of cobblers, but he despised the idea of honest work and ran away from home, shortly after sullying his hands with disreputable work. Having achieved an acceptable level of mastery, he was invited to join the thieves guild but turned them down because of his loner personality. Even now he continues his "occupation" alone. 

He became a regular at the public house because he had set his sights on Lusit, that connection soon led him to join the adventurers guild afterwards.

[Spoiler] Serafino's dexterity with his hands and fingers allowed him to be a thief, helping parties with trap detection and disarming during dungeon explorations. He tells a local boy, Harry, that brawn and magic aren't the only prerequisites to becoming an adventurer. The key to successful adventurers in his own mind is finding a niche role that facilitates cooperation and problem solving, allowing expeditions to succeed and all members returning alive. 

When Harry is abducted by the local gangsters and compelled to kill Hitsuji guild members in return for his family's safety, Serafino uses this knowledge to his advantage and turns the tables on the gangster boss through clever use of misinformation and deception. Serafino is relieved Harry is safe and is given an apprenticeship with a cobbler as he doesn't think the latter would be cut out for a career which required deception to survive. [/Spoiler]
